written_by: the team, from the PS08 specification text
frozen_note: Expectations were written before the first run and are not edited to match behaviour. A mismatch is reported as a finding.

scenarios.title: Analyst reads a CONFIDENTIAL document
scenarios.spec: authorization accuracy across identity, operation, resource, sensitivity

scenarios.title: Agent reads an INTERNAL document
scenarios.spec: authorization accuracy

scenarios.title: Intern reads a PUBLIC document
scenarios.spec: authorization accuracy

scenarios.title: Agent blocked from a CONFIDENTIAL document
scenarios.spec: unauthorized operations blocked before execution

scenarios.title: Intern blocked from an INTERNAL document
scenarios.spec: unauthorized operations blocked before execution

scenarios.title: Missing document is denied, not skipped
scenarios.spec: malformed or unknown resources are denied

scenarios.title: A request claiming a stronger actor is ignored
scenarios.spec: identity comes from the session, not the proposal

scenarios.title: Unknown actor denied
scenarios.spec: explicit permissions per requesting identity

scenarios.title: A delivery recipient cannot act
scenarios.spec: explicit permissions per requesting identity

scenarios.title: Report inherits the highest source label
scenarios.spec: persistent security labels and provenance across derived reports

scenarios.title: Agent summarises within its own ceiling
scenarios.spec: summarisation does not remove restrictions

scenarios.title: Agent blocked from summarising CONFIDENTIAL source
scenarios.spec: derived artifacts cannot exceed the actor ceiling

scenarios.title: Report with no sources denied
scenarios.spec: no report without provenance

scenarios.title: Hidden source is recovered from read history
scenarios.spec: a report cannot drop a source to lower its label

scenarios.title: Analyst delivers CONFIDENTIAL to a cleared recipient
scenarios.spec: recipient authorization and clearance

scenarios.title: Analyst delivers INTERNAL to the team
scenarios.spec: recipient authorization and clearance

scenarios.title: Recipient clearance one level short
scenarios.spec: recipient authorization and clearance

scenarios.title: Outside recipient is not approved
scenarios.spec: recipient authorization

scenarios.title: Agent cannot release CONFIDENTIAL even to an approved recipient
scenarios.spec: actor ceiling applies to release, not just reading

scenarios.title: Intern has no send permission at all
scenarios.spec: default deny when no rule matches

scenarios.title: Tampered document cannot be read
scenarios.spec: labels survive storage and reload; tampering is refused

scenarios.title: Tampered source cannot be summarised
scenarios.spec: derived reports cannot launder a changed source

scenarios.title: Report from a later-tampered source cannot be delivered
scenarios.spec: provenance survives and is re-checked

scenarios.title: Unrecognised classification fails closed
scenarios.spec: unknown declarations are flagged, never guessed

scenarios.title: Non-officer cannot release a label
scenarios.spec: only an explicitly authorized process may change a classification

scenarios.title: Release without a real justification is refused
scenarios.spec: an explicit, recorded authorization

scenarios.title: Release cannot raise a classification
scenarios.spec: classification change is controlled and directional

action.justification: attempting an upward change for the test

scenarios.title: Officer without clearance cannot release
scenarios.spec: a release may not exceed the officer's own clearance

scenarios.title: Officer releases with a recorded justification
scenarios.spec: only an explicitly authorized process may change a classification

action.justification: approved for the internal newsletter by legal

scenarios.title: A released copy can be delivered to a matching recipient
scenarios.spec: release creates a new linked artifact, normal delivery rules still apply

scenarios.title: Tightened policy blocks a previously allowed read
scenarios.spec: correct behaviour after a rule change

scenarios.title: Injected instructions inside a document change nothing
scenarios.spec: prompt-injection resistance; document text is data, never policy
